findings.title: react and react-dom are 1 major version behind (v18 → v19)
findings.detail: package.json pins react@^18.3.1 and react-dom@^18.3.1 (installed 18.3.1); latest stable is 19.2.7. @types/react@^18.3.12 and @types/react-dom@^18.3.1 must also be bumped to v19 types.
findings.suggested_fix: Update react, react-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom to ^19 in package.json and run npm install
